usageNotes: Use this endpoint to audit the APT repository configuration on a specific PDM node — useful before running updates or troubleshooting package availability. The response includes a top-level SHA256 digest that must be passed to any subsequent write operations to guard against concurrent modification. Check the 'errors' array first; parse failures mean the repository state is unreliable and updates should not proceed.

examples.summary: Retrieve APT repository list for node 'pdm1'

tips: The top-level 'digest' field is a concurrency guard — pass it to any repository write API to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.

The 'standard-repos' array shows whether Proxmox enterprise/no-subscription/test repos are configured and whether each is currently enabled, making it easy to spot missing or disabled official sources.
A non-empty 'errors' array means one or more /etc/apt/ files could not be parsed; treat repository state as incomplete until the errors are resolved.
The 'infos' array surfaces warnings (e.g. deprecated suite names or mixed signed/unsigned repos) even when parsing succeeds — review before applying updates.
